avis.texte: I am absolutely in LOVE with this Mineral 89 Fragrance free Cream! First of all, we see the packaging is a beautiful moment in itself. But then we have the fact that it's FRAGRANCE FREE, sold right there. Lastly, the quality of this cream is literally SO lovely on my skin. This is def going down as a must have in my skin care products for life.

My skin desperately needed this. This moisturizer absorbs right in making you feel super soft without feeling like you have a heavy layer of film on top of your skin. I do have combination skin with an oily t-zone. This is NOT for oilier skin types imo but is wonderful in the dryer areas.
I use this before I put on my face lotion. It absolutely leaves my face feeling soft and glowy!! I would say it give me extra moisture. I love that it's in a glass jar and also really has no scent.

This moisturizer has a very nice light feel. It absorbs quickly into the skin and keeps your skin hydrated for hours. My skin looks healthier since I've been using this for the past couple of weeks. I like how it's truly fragrance free so that can be good for people with sensitivities to smells. Very happy with this moisturizer!

So many products claim to be fragrance-free but definitely have a residual scent. That is not the case with this cream! It's so smooth and doesn't feel greasy on my combination skin. I would definitely re-purchase.
This is a great moisturizer. It doesn't break my face out, or irritate it. It's a little thicker than I am used to, but it's not necessarily a bad thing. Overall, I really like it.

This is a thick moisturizer (a little goes a long way) and is perfect for my night time routine. The best part is that it's fragrance-free. If you suffer from facial dryness, you can apply this moisturizer at night time and wake up with moisturizer skin. I love it!
I was very impressed with the results and I plan to buy more after running out!
I really liked this product. I find it very rich so if your skin is oily I wouldn't recommend it. My skin is combination so it works nicely leaving it super smooth and glowy.

The Mineral 89 Fragrance Free Cream is what I have been looking for in a moisturizer. It has a medium thickness water like texture, that just melts into the skin. Great for all skin types even oily skin like mine, since it provides a lot of hydration in one thin layer! No scent obviously which is amazing since I have acne prone skin which can be irritated sometimes due to heavily-fragranced products. This moisturizer is unique because it has Pure Hyaluronic Acid, Vitamin B3, Vitamin E, and Squalene. These ingredients make it perfect to restore my moisture barrier on the nights I use retinol. I love how lightweight and how my skin drinks this up like water. I will definitely purchase this once I finish the bottle.

First time trying out this Vichy Laboratory Mineral 89 and after continuously using it for several days I can actually say that my skin is loving it! The texture is really light and it melts on your skin. It's super lightweight and my skin feels soft and moisturized especially when applying it before bedtime then waking up the next morning, my skin looks hydrated and fresh! I love it! I would definitely continue using this product to see better results!
I love how this product is unscented and helps retain skin's moisture with squalane. It's very lightweight to the skin that's great for my sensitive skin.

This moisturizer is so light and refreshing! I normally have combination skin with an very oily T zone, this cream does not leave me feeling oily or having break outs! It has become my new favorite moisturizer!

avis.titre: Everything you could want in a face cream
avis.texte: I LOVE this fragrance free face cream. It's so light and moisturizing while not being sticky or oily. It absorbs almost immediately and I can tell after just one week of using it that my skin texture is much more consistent and smooth… exactly what I wanted! I also LOVE that it doesn't have a fragrance- not even a chemical smell. It feels very high end and I will definitely continue using it.
This cream has a lightweight texture that quickly absorbs into my skin, leaving it feeling hydrated, soothed, and nourished. Plus, it's suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin.
